credential_pattern_scan.scope_limit: Simple credential signatures in decoded recommended UTF-8 text; compressed artifacts not rescanned internally. Absolute paths in historical evidence are expected and preserved, not credential findings.

recommendations: Stage only listed explicit files or narrowly reviewed directories; never use blanket git add -f for B3 adapter root.
Keep B3 local .gitignore qa_*_tmp/ and __pycache__/ exclusions; all excluded test sandboxes are local QA outputs.
Force-add only the explicit requires_force_add_paths: these are preserved evidence logs, not all ignored files.
Preserve byte-bound source snapshots/logs/JSON/CSV/SVG and archive members with appropriate -text attributes before adding; compare staged blob SHA to this snapshot for bound originals.
No file over 20 MiB in recommended scope is automatically rejected; review largest list and use exact per-volume archive boundaries.
This is a bounded pending-file inventory, not permission to freeze scientific results or complete review of adapter semantics.
